description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git merge and cherry-pick operations with different diff algorithms, specifically focusing on the influence of the diff algorithm on merge output. It contains test cases that set up repository states, perform operations with different diff algorithms, and check success or failure conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of commands unless overridden.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the specified command to fail.
